info.name: AI RAG Service (Node.js & Gemini)
info.description:
## AI RAG Service API Contract

**Base URL:** `https://sih2026-86kl.onrender.com`

* **GET `/health`** — Check whether AI service is running.
* **POST `/api/ai/tender/process`** — Process tender PDF via Cloudinary URL → extract text → chunk → generate embeddings → store in pgvector.
* **POST `/api/ai/bidder/process`** — Process bidder PDF via Cloudinary URL → extract text → chunk → generate embeddings → store in pgvector.
* **POST `/api/ai/bidder-tender-chat/ask`** ⭐ — Main chatbot API. Spring Boot sends the officer's question; Node retrieves **tender + bidder + ML summary** context and generates the Gemini response.

### Flow
`Spring Boot → Node AI Service → RAG (Tender + Bidder + ML Summary) → Gemini → Node → Spring Boot → React`

**Note:** The final qualification/disqualification decision remains with the Procurement Officer.
